COG.note: The page is one programme's open data page and states no national open data policy.

facts.fact: The SYNA-MNV programme of Congo's forest economy ministry publishes five datasets for download on its open data page, the newest dated 2024.
The SYNA-MNV programme states its datasets are published under an open licence, with reuse requiring the credit 'Source : SYNA-MNV - Republique du Congo'.
